overview:
PeaLang help
usage:
  help()              list all topics
  help("match")       detailed help for a topic
available topics:
  variables, functions, control_flow, iterators, match, exceptions, async, types, list, dict, strings, stats, web, ai, modules, macros, scopes, conformance, freeze, optimize, fast, jit, cli, scaffold, frameworks, devx, health
variables:
Variables & bindings
  let x = 5          declare (immutable by convention)
  const PI = 3.14    declare a constant
  let [a,b] = pair   destructure a list/tuple
  let {name} = user  destructure a dict
iterators:
Iterators
  let it = iter([1, 2, 3])
  next(it)                      consume one value
  next(it, default)             consume with exhaustion default
  has_next(it)                  non-consuming lookahead
  peek(it)                      inspect next value without consuming
  for x in it { ... }           loops share and close the same iterator
  Iterable<T>, Iterator<T>       static contracts; I201 for non-iterables
match:
Pattern matching (statement and expression)
  match x {
    1 => "one",
    [a, b] => a + b,
    {"key": v} => v,
    _ => "other"
  }
  wildcard: _ , literal, list, and dict patterns supported
exceptions:
Exceptions
  throw expr                            raise a UserError or structured error value
  error(kind, message, code, cause)     create a structured error value
  try { ... } catch e { ... }           catch any exception
  try { ... } catch ZeroDivisionError e { ... }   typed catch
  try { ... } catch TypeError as e { ... }        typed catch with 'as'
  try { ... } catch e { ... } finally { ... }
  assert cond, "message"              assert with a custom message
  Exception kinds: PeaException, UserError, NameError, ValueError, TypeError,
                   IndexError, KeyError, ZeroDivisionError, ScopeError,
                   AssertionError, AttributeError, ImportError
  Catch binding fields: e["schema"], e["kind"], e["message"], e["code"],
                        e["cause"], e["context"], e["source"], e["line"],
                        e["column"], e["end_line"], e["end_col"],
                        e["frames"], e["trace"]
  Structured errors carry a stable schema, optional error code, cause chain,
  and source span; typed catches match both interpreter and bytecode VM runs
async:
Async & parallel
  async function f() { ... }
  let x = await f()
  concurrency.sleep(seconds)        cancellable delay
  concurrency.spawn(awaitable)      start a task and return its handle
  concurrency.gather(awaitables)    await a list of tasks
  concurrency.timeout(seconds, task) deadline wrapper
  concurrency.result(task)          await a spawned task
  concurrency.cancel(task)          cancel a spawned task
  Future<T> contracts; A201 for awaiting known non-futures
  PARALLEL { expr1, expr2, expr3 }
list:
Lists
  let xs = [1, 2, 3]
  xs[0], xs[1:], xs[-1]
  [x * 2 for x in xs if x > 1]         list comprehension
  {k: v for [k,v] in items}             dict comprehension
  len(xs), sum(xs), sorted(xs), reversed(xs)
  map(f, xs), filter(f, xs), all(xs), any(xs)
dict:
Dicts
  let d = {"a": 1, "b": 2}
  d["a"], d.get("a", default), d.has("a")
  keys(d), values(d), items(d)
  merge(d1, d2), deep_merge(d1, d2)
  get_path(d, "a.b.c", default)
strings:
Strings
  "hello" + " world"                    concat
  "{x}" inside double-quoted strings       interpolation syntax
  upper(s), lower(s), trim(s)
  split(s, sep), strip_prefix, strip_suffix
  replace(s, a, b), repeat(s, n)
  contains(s, sub), starts_with(s, p), ends_with(s, p)
  pad_start(s, width, fill), pad_end(s, width, fill)
  snake_case(s), kebab_case(s), slugify(s)
stats:
Statistics & numerics (std.stats)
  Imported as: let stats = std.stats  (or registered by default)
  Provided by the pealang.numerics module
  mean, median, stddev, corr  (see std.stats for full list)
web:
Web (std.web)
  let app = web.app()
  app.enable_cors("*")
  app.get("/path", handlerFn)
  app.post("/path", handlerFn)
  app.serve("127.0.0.1", 8080)
  web.health()  web.json(x)  web.text(s)  web.envelope(data, meta)
  web.created(x)  web.not_found(msg)  app.dispatch(method, path)
ai:
AI (std.ai)
  set_ai_key("openai", "sk-...")
  get_ai_status()
  list_ai_providers()
  run_ai_query("openai", "gpt-4", "prompt")
  CloudModel / LocalModel / AIConfig (see pea_ai module)
modules:
Modules
  import "./file.pea"              import a file
  import "./file.pea" as alias      import with alias
  import "pkg.client" as client    project/dependency module
  export name                       re-export from a module
  Modules export their top-level bindings
  Shared resolution handles aliases, caches, cycles, and project manifests
  Project analysis reports M201 unresolved imports and M203 import cycles
macros:
Safe metaprogramming
  expand_source_macros(source, expander)  validated macro expansion
  compile_source_with_macros(source, name, expander)
  SafeMacro(name, pattern, template, hygiene, max_uses)
  $name captures matched source; @name introduces a hygienic temporary
  Definitions are bounded and report MG101-MG203 issues
  Legacy string macros remain available from pealang.type_system
scopes:
Resource scopes
  using name = resource { ... }     bind a resource for the block only
  close() or dispose() is called on block exit, including errors
  scopes current()                  inspect the active runtime scope
  ResourceScope / ResourceScopeManager are available to hosts
  Nested scopes inherit budget limits and clean up in LIFO order
  Project analysis reports R201 duplicate bindings and R202 reassigned bindings
conformance:
Conformance suite
  pea conformance           0.40 differential + fuzz harness
  pea conformance-v2        curated Wave 1 language-core suite
  ConformanceCaseV2(id, name, category, kind, source, ...)
  run_conformance_suite_v2() -> stable per-case, per-runtime report
  conformance_gate_v2() -> PASS/FAIL gate for CI
  Cases cover runtime parity, macros, static diagnostics, and module graphs
freeze:
Frozen 3.0 core
  pea freeze                  verify API, conformance, spec and surface gates
  CORE_SURFACES               named surfaces frozen for the 3.0 core
  verify_core_freeze() -> stable PASS/FAIL report
  core_freeze_report() -> CLI report with manifest digest
  The freeze gate is additive-only and rejects unexpected API removals
optimize:
Bytecode optimizer
  pea optimize FILE.pea [--verify] [-o OUT.peac]
  optimize_bytecode(module) -> optimized BytecodeModule copy
  optimize_report(module) -> pass counts, digest and PASS/FAIL gate
  verify_optimization() -> VM output/result parity
  Passes: constant folding, dead literal push/pop, unreachable code
  Use --no-constant-folding, --no-dead-push-pop, --no-unreachable-code to disable a pass
fast:
Fast interpreter
  pea fast FILE.pea [--verify] [--benchmark] [--optimize]
  FastInterpreter.run(module) -> direct-handler execution when supported
  fast_path_supported(module) -> eligibility without running the program
  verify_fast_parity() -> VM output/result parity check
  benchmark_fast() -> median wall-clock comparison
  Unsupported bytecode automatically falls back to the standard VM
jit:
Bytecode JIT
  pea jit FILE.pea [--verify] [--benchmark] [--optimize] [--threshold N]
  profile_execution(module) -> instruction counts from a profiling run
  select_traces(module, profile) -> hot loop back-edges
  JITRuntime.run(module) -> compiled traces with guarded specialization
  verify_jit_parity() -> VM output/result parity check
  benchmark_jit() -> median wall-clock comparison
  Guard failures deoptimize to the standard VM without changing output
cli:
CLI
  pea run FILE.pea                 run a script
  pea eval -e EXPR                 evaluate an expression
  pea repl                         interactive REPL
  pea serve FILE.pea               serve as an HTTP app
  pea scaffold <framework> <dir>   generate a backend service skeleton
  pea scaffold fullstack <dir>     generate backend + frontend monorepo
  pea doctor [path]                environment + project health diagnostics
  pea health [path] [--json]       project health gate (type/lint aggregate)
  pea readiness                    readiness/evidence report
  pea help [topic]                 CLI help topics
  pea info                         version + available namespaces
  pea conformance-v2               curated language-core conformance report
  pea freeze                       frozen 3.0 core gate report
  pea optimize FILE.pea [--verify]  optimize bytecode and report pass counts
  pea fast FILE.pea [--verify]      run bytecode on the fast interpreter
  pea jit FILE.pea [--verify]       profile and run hot traces with JIT guards
  pea --help                       command list
  pea audit [--write-interface-doc] repository audit closure checks
  pea deps --security [--advisories F] [--policy F]  dependency advisory and license scan
  pea workspace init|add|list|graph|lock  manage multi-package workspaces
  pea cache put|get|list|remove|export|import  offline package cache bundles
  pea plugin init|list|verify|load  trusted plugin manifests and capability policy
  pea openapi-contract FILE.json   generate OpenAPI from service contract
  pea diagnose FILE.pea            single-file type/lint/health report
scaffold:
Scaffolding
  pea scaffold fastapi ./svc          FastAPI backend skeleton
  pea scaffold flask ./svc            Flask backend skeleton
  pea scaffold express ./svc          Express backend skeleton
  pea scaffold gin ./svc              Gin backend skeleton
  pea scaffold django ./svc           Django backend skeleton
  pea scaffold fullstack ./app --frontend react|nextjs --backend fastapi
  Generates health endpoint, tests, Dockerfile, and README.
  See also: help("frameworks")
  Scaffolds include starter service_contract.json and openapi.json.
frameworks:
Frameworks & architecture toolkit (analysis/frameworks namespace)
  scaffold_backend(name, framework, port)
  scaffold_fullstack(name, backend, frontend, port)
  write_scaffold(name, kind, target_dir, ...)
  service_contract(service, routes, version)
  service_contract_to_openapi(contract, ...)  -> OpenAPI 3.0 spec
  openapi_json(contract, ...)                 -> JSON string
  adr(title, context, decision, consequences, status, adr_number)
  adr_index(records), adr_filter(records, status, owner), adr_transition(record, status)
  layered_architecture_check(source)
  openapi-contract CLI: convert service_contract.json -> OpenAPI 3.0 spec
devx:
Developer experience (analysis/devx namespace)
  diagnose_source(source, source_name) -> ok/health/counts/diagnostics
  project_check(project_root, max_files) -> aggregate .pea diagnostics
  cheatsheet(topic)
  suggest_fix(error_msg), explain_error_detailed(error, source, line)
  lint_source(source), format_source(source), code_metrics(source)
  dependency_check(manifest_path), project_scaffold(name, template, target_dir)
  CLI: pea diagnose <file> for per-file health; pea health <dir> for project gate
health:
Health & diagnostics
  pea doctor [path]      environment info + optional project health totals
  pea health [path]      aggregate type/lint diagnostics for .pea files (CI gate)
  pea readiness          readiness report (gates + project health metadata)
  diagnose_source() and project_check() are available in the analysis/devx namespaces
  project_check totals: files, errors, warnings, infos, ok
  pea audit          repository audit closure (interface/doc/version gates)
  pea diagnose FILE.pea  per-file diagnostics with health score and exit code
